lyrics: Walk back
to the        market gate, thought my
years would hold their sway.   Walk
back to the market   gate, thought my
years would hold their sway.   Had the
skills, the   drive, the will, felt ready
for another day.   But a number
on the page   made 'em just
look past the fray.   I'm just a
number to them   in this corporate
hiring game. Don't see the steady current
in my soul,   don't even bother
with my name.   They want the young,
the fresh, the cheap.   Don't care what wisdom
I can bring.   Yeah, just a
number to them,   and that's the cruelest
song they     sing.
Used
to lead the charge, embrace the change,
always learning,   always keen.
Used to lead the charge,   embrace the change,
always learning,   always keen.
Help build    futures rearranged
through every   digital scene.
But the younger faces   at the screen
see no future,   just what's been.
I'm just a    number to them
in this corporate   hiring game.
Don't see the steady current   in my soul,
don't even bother   with my name.
They want the young,   the fresh, the cheap.
Don't care what wisdom   I can bring.
Yeah, just a   number to them,
and that's the cruelest   song they
sing.
Got the spirit,
keen and strong,   got clear vision,
sharp and true.   Got the spirit,
keen and strong,   got clear vision,
sharp and true.   Ready to adapt
to take on new   everything
I need to do.   But the door stays closed,
won't let me prove   my worth is more
than just a view.   They talk
of innovation,   future bright
and boldly cast.   But real insight
born of patience   is a treasure
built to truly last.   More
than hurried answers,   more than just
a youthful gleam.   It's the depth
of understanding   built on
every single dream.   I'm just a
number to them   in this corporate
hiring game.   Don't see the steady current
in my soul,   don't even bother
with my name.   They want the young,
the fresh,    the cheap. Don't care what wisdom
I can bring. Yeah, just a
number to them,   and that's the cruelest
song they     sing.
Cruelest
song they sing.
Yeah.
Just a number
in
this aging    scheme.
